claims.value: Mistral Small 3 (2501) is a 24B parameter instruction-fine-tuned model, an instruction-fine-tuned version of Mistral-Small-24B-Base-2501. It features a 32k context window, native function calling, and a Tekken tokenizer with a 131k vocabulary size.
The model is licensed under Apache 2.0, allowing both commercial and non-commercial usage and modification.
